build_CombinedSpatiotemporalModel: build a CombinedSpatiotemporalModel combining a spatial model and temporal model for joint log-likelihood computation
build_JumpCNFSpatiotemporalModel: build a JumpCNFSpatiotemporalModel with shared hidden state dynamics between spatial and temporal components
build_SelfAttentiveCNFSpatiotemporalMode: build a SelfAttentiveCNFSpatiotemporalModel using self-attention CNF for spatial modeling with shared temporal hidden state
build_JumpGMMSpatiotemporalModel: build a JumpGMMSpatiotemporalModel using conditional GMM for spatial modeling with configurable number of mixtures
run_SpatiotemporalModel_forward: run the forward pass of a SpatiotemporalModel to compute spatial and temporal log-likelihoods from event data
